data.description:
## testing_mode: UPDATE
## TDD Exemption: no conditional logic — pure wiring config change (unit exemption criterion 1)

## What
Add check-precondition-emit.sh as a pre-commit hook entry in .pre-commit-config.yaml following the existing pre-commit-wrapper.sh pattern.

## YAML Entry to Add (after portability-check entry)
  - id: precondition-emit-check
    name: Precondition Emit Check (5s timeout)
    entry: ./plugins/dso/scripts/pre-commit-wrapper.sh precondition-emit-check 5 "plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh"
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    stages: [pre-commit]
    files: ^plugins/dso/skills/

## 3aaa-0238 Boundary Note
Add a comment in .pre-commit-config.yaml above the new entry:
# Note (3aaa-0238 boundary): if the 3aaa-0238 CI gate manifest ships first and provides
# a centralized hook registration mechanism, migrate this entry to use that mechanism.
# Ship direct pre-commit-config.yaml wire for now; 3aaa-0238 integrates on landing.

## Consideration (S4 must land AFTER S2)
S4 (this story) MUST be merged AFTER S2 (3346-0c82) is merged. S2 instruments all 11 target skill files with EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmarks. If S4 lands before S2, the keyword detector fires on existing fallthrough prose already present in those files and blocks commits. The story deps (depends_on 3346-0c82) enforce this ordering at the epic level.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Hook entry registered in .pre-commit-config.yaml
   Verify: grep -q 'precondition-emit-check' .pre-commit-config.yaml
2. Entry uses correct script path
   Verify: grep -q 'check-precondition-emit.sh' .pre-commit-config.yaml
3. Lint passes
   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py (N/A — no Python changes)
data.title: Register check-precondition-emit.sh in .pre-commit-config.yaml; document 3aaa-0238 boundary
